thread:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the INC-2026-03 postmortem — we listed 6 action items. Can owners confirm and provide a due date? I'll keep this thread as the tracker.

Divya: I can own action 1 (fix autoscaler scaling-edge case). Target ETA 2026-03-22. I'll open the PR today and tag reviewers.

Ryan: I'll take action 2 (add KV cache metrics + SLO dashboard). ETA 2026-03-25. Heads up: need a small schema field for the exporter, will call out in the issue. @Jules can you help review the dashboard layout?

Jules: Yup, I can review the dashboard + schema notes. Plan to review by 2026-03-24.

Deploy Bot: rollback completed for canary group at 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z — reason: high tail latency.

Maria: I'll own action 3 (postmortem doc edits + add RCA diagrams). I'll have the updated doc and diagrams by 2026-03-21. Link to current draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/INC-2026-03/postmortem (I'll attach SVGs).

Tom: I'll take action 4 (permission hardening + audit logs). ETA 2026-03-29. Opening a draft PR and will request security review.

Alex: Two cross-team items: action 5 (routing policy refinement) needs both Platform and SRE changes — @Divya please coordinate with @Tom on implementation plan. Proposed due 2026-03-28.

Divya: I'll sync with Tom tomorrow morning. I propose we break action 5 into: (a) policy change + config migration, (b) canary test plan. Will post an implementation checklist here. Also suggest 10m async updates in this thread each day until done.

Ryan: For action 2 follow-up, I'll also add an alert test (action 6) to validate the metric pipeline — ETA 2026-03-26.

Jules: Quick question re action 2: does adding the KV metric require a DB migration or schema rollout? @Ryan

Ryan: No DB migration — it's an in-memory export and a prometheus scrape addition. Should be low-risk.

Maria: Confirmed doc link above; I'll add the final RCA diagram and the timeline before 03/21.

Alex: Agreed on the mini check-ins. I'll publish an action tracker here in the morning (simple checklist). If anyone needs to change their ETA, reply here with the new date and reason. Use :warning: if it blocks other teams.

Divya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234 — autoscaler fix. Marking ETA 2026-03-22.

Tom: Draft PR for permission hardening: https://github.com/redwood/security/pull/456 — WIP, tests failing on CI atm. ETA still 03/29 but might slip a few days if CI fails.

Alex: Summary (I'll copy to the postmortem and ops board):

```
- Action 1: Autoscaler fix — Divya — due 2026-03-22 — PR #1234
- Action 2: KV cache metrics + dashboard — Ryan — due 2026-03-25
- Action 3: Postmortem doc + RCA diagrams — Maria — due 2026-03-21
- Action 4: Permission hardening + audit logs — Tom — due 2026-03-29
- Action 5: Routing policy (Platform+SRE) — Divya & Tom — due 2026-03-28
- Action 6: Alert test for metric pipeline — Ryan — due 2026-03-26
```

Alex: I'll ping owners next Tue if there isn't an update. Thanks everyone — please drop brief status lines here as you make progress. :thumbsup:
